title: Reduce general multiplier setup with streamed ternary cover stock
body:
This construction reduces fixed setup, generated instructions, tape count and the minimum stock needed by the general mixed-rank integer multiplier. It preserves the proposed complete saving **κ = 0.00387992803556** for arbitrary signed binary operands. Its largest improvement comes from removing the fixed program entry and physical tape for every invertible low matrix. A separate change to the finite branch gives a measured 108.11-fold speedup over the published Python implementation on 33,554,432-bit operands. [Complete resource proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/STREAMED-MACHINE.md) · [Carrier proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/CARRIER-PROOF.md) · [Exact receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/EVIDENCE.json) · [Measurements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/MEASUREMENTS.json)

| Quantity | Pinned complete construction | This construction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Binary dimension | 2^1285200000000000 | 2^240000000000000 |
| Complex dimension | 2^15171300000000000000 | 2^3300000000 |
| Ordinary radix and elementary buckets | q > 2^6426000000000045, with q² buckets | 3 and 9 |
| Fixed setup, generated code and peak fixed backing | The low splitter alone requires log₂(log₂ S) > 2570399999999999 | The entire fixed machine has S ≤ 2^4800000000000000000, so log₂(log₂ S) < 63 |
| Ordinary width in radix digits | Necessary log₂ e > 2580722891566266 | Sufficient log₂ e ≥ 481927710843386 for all six stock reserves |

The baseline's splitter explicitly names and writes to each of its L = B·|GL| destination tapes. That gives a lower bound on its emitted program even if a separate matrix directory is generated on demand. The new router temporarily extends the real low rows to the full ternary matrix cube, less than doubling this local volume. It transports every high value and carry, finishes the low right action, and removes the singular rows before calling a child. Removing singular rows earlier can destroy genuine data. Five temporary spools replace the L-dependent splitter bank at the cost of O((1 + log₃ L)V) moves per split, compared with the earlier bound of 94V. Serial stacks preserve independently changed child returns. [Old physical splitter](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing/PROOF.md) · [Streaming implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/streaming_routes.py) · [Sibling transfers](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/SERIAL-LOW.md)

A chronological compiler gives each selected coordinate either one or five occurrences. The signed complex action has order four and each aligned binary exchange has order two. This buys the smaller dimensions and funds all nine children of an alternate ternary pivot. The build includes separately owned zero fields, the actual ordered paid requests, high-field routing, both directions and erasure. The written complete fixed-tape bound is S + C n (1 + log n)^(1−κ) time and S + O(n) backing. A conservative bound for C is a common outer factor times (N_b^20000)^100. Its least value and the cofinal wall-clock crossover remain unknown. The direct outer controller first admits one axis at **2,575,826,973 × 2^2575826941 + 1 bits**. It can use elementary work at that length. [Compiler and ownership](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/PERIODIC.md) · [Stock, generation and input thresholds](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/MACHINE.md) · [Weighted leaf](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/lean/TernaryRouting.lean)

At feasible lengths, the compiled two-prime branch takes 1.170 seconds versus 126.519 seconds for the pinned Python caller and 0.169 seconds for GMP on the same 33,554,432-bit inputs (median times across the same three input pairs). The C work area is 64 MiB there. At 4,194,304 bits the measured process peak rose from 34,766,848 to 40,026,112 bytes. The comparison includes the move from Python to C. The finite scalar routine also ran inside the direct Fourier product. The full three-transform regression on (3,5) used the true ternary low router in both input CRTs and the inverse CRT. The production-size generated machine remains beyond hardware. [Dispatcher](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/multiply.py) · [Packed C](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/short_product.c) · [Finite integration and comparisons](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/PRACTICAL.md)

From the repository root use CPython 3.12 for the registered checks. For the formal checks, install the pinned Lean 4.34.1 toolchain and mathlib dependencies.

```sh
p=research/bounded-general-multiplier
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package "$p"
python3.12 -IB "$p/verify_formal.py"
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bounded-general-multiplier outcome=completed
PASS_GENERAL_KERNEL 18 modules 51 axiom reports ['Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound', 'propext']
```

The seven portable commands passed in an immutable Git-free export. Independent address oracles checked 384,426 right-route records. The complete product returned 345550037539 and uncarried coefficients 11811, 10996, 4152, 868, 77. ASan and UBSan passed 1,073 additional packed products and three invalid extents. Lean checks carrier funding, chronological action, the core weighted leaf, cube padding and simultaneous stock. The native bindings, full machine clock and Fourier-to-tape composition have written proofs. Unchanged historical analytic suites were not replayed in full. Independent scientific review remains open. [Reproduction and formal coverage](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/VERIFICATION.md) · [Source hashes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c/research/bounded-general-multiplier/SOURCES.json)

GitHub's onboarding step ran 760 tests. One navigation test failed and 24 tests were skipped. The selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify` and the CI guide documents `make frontier6030-verify`. The same assertion fails on the unmodified base. GitHub skipped its hosted package replay. [Hosted failure](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44861532354/job/136715797504) · [Assertion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/tests/test_research_current_status.py#L58) · [Base guide](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/ci-verification.md#L9).

For the GMP comparison, the benchmark host used GMP 6.3.0 under the following prefix. Set the prefix to the installed headers and library on another host. The benchmark times complete products and checks every result outside the timer.

```sh
p=research/bounded-general-multiplier
gmp_prefix=/opt/homebrew/opt/gmp
gmp_adapter=/tmp/bounded-multiply-gmp-benchmark.so
cc -std=c11 -O3 -fPIC -shared "$p/short_product.c" -o "$p/short_product.so"
cc -std=c11 -O3 -fPIC -shared -I"$gmp_prefix/include" "$p/bench_gmp.c" -L"$gmp_prefix/lib" -lgmp -o "$gmp_adapter"
python3.12 -IB "$p/benchmark.py" "$p/short_product.so" --gmp-library "$gmp_adapter" --sizes 4096 16384 65536 262144 1048576 4194304 --rounds 5
python3.12 -IB "$p/benchmark.py" "$p/short_product.so" --gmp-library "$gmp_adapter" --sizes 33554432 --rounds 3 --skip-profile
```

The concurrent 451-factor proposal advertises κ = 0.00387992804346, a difference of 0.00000000000790. Its consumer retains five premises, including the seven-stage physical and precision transfer from a completed seed. The comparisons above use the six-stage 480-factor proposal that has a written complete realization. [PR #7863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7863) · [451-factor proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781/research/p104-bit-451-factor-schedule/PROOF.md) · [Consumer receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781/research/p104-bit-451-factor-schedule/CONSUMER.json).

The base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. @Clear1nsight supplied the mixed price at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The native all-column words are at `a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e`, their uniform composition at `343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602` and the direct caller at `3615fd982f2f4dc7172bef6f0dc9a4f77d5ab6dd`. The fixed-port router by @thu-nmrc and the prior finite compiler, batching, pivoted fallback and single-grade work retain their source credits. @aliromman prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
